metadata.name: Cell — CHEMOTAXIS BASELINE (reactive run-and-tumble, scalar scent)
metadata.description: BASELINE — NOT a Markov-blanket loop and NOT part of the active-inference system. A SINGLE reactive run-and-tumble chemotaxis controller (the E. coli strategy: raise the tumble rate when the scalar scent stops rising) steering the body directly. No arbiter, no map/planner, no play, no vision, no cross-loop model — one reflex, one motor stack. This is the report's §6 external baseline: in this same study room (40m, scalar-only, ring off) it forages ~1.9 eats, vs the full 4-loop composition's ~0.9 (which, as shipped, sits at the random-walk floor). Run it beside the_cell_arbiter_room_pillars_vision.json to see the yardstick the composition must beat. docs/reports/cell_markov_blanket_loops_report.md §6.
metadata._comment_forage: falloff 12->15 (2026-07-05 sweep): the reach fix for far-field quad foraging. At 12 the bug could not home across a 24m zone (first eat ~t13400, eat-gated reveal effectively dead); at 15 the first eat lands ~t1213 (11x faster) and the bug actually forages the revealed zones. 15 is the reach ceiling (>=16 flattens the screened-Poisson field -> no climbable gradient). Higher energy_drain, food-at-connector, and smaller room ALL tested WORSE. Honest limit: self-driven 4-zone completion is a capability limit (the bug reaches NE/NW but, full right after an eat, plays instead of foraging the far center food) -> the timed reveal (wall_drop_period) backstops hands-off completeness; the FIRST connector is eat-earned.
metadata._comment_scent: publish_scent_ring=false → the body virtualizes scent POSITION-ONLY (a scalar sampled at the bug's centre, frame-independent 'bath'). The directional 8-nostril ring (reality.proprio.scent) is a scaffold / different sensory modality and is fully bypassed here — nothing in this config consumes it (klino=RunTumbleNav is scalar run-and-tumble, direction emerges from motion). Defensible chemotaxis: no directional read of the source.
metadata._comment_quad: QUAD adaptability env: 2x2 spiral of 4 zones (SW->SE->NE->NW) of increasing complexity, isolated by a + cross with 3 DROPPABLE connectors. Bug boxed in Z1; connectors open on wall_drop_period ticks (headless) or KEY_D (UI). One fixed food per zone. Demonstrates the planner+confinement-steer discovering new zones as they open.
metadata._comment_respawn: quad_respawn_single: eat all 4 zone foods first (one-shot, clears the board), THEN respawn one food at a time at a random zone → the bug must re-find a single moving target across the revealed maze. Exercises the 3-loop division.

params._comment: LEARNED advance (genuine 'act on a heading') + wedge-escape safety net + explore-on-lost. Defensible action layer.
params._comment_hk: advance_homeokinetic: reward = max(0,vel_fwd) − effort·|vel_fwd| (food-DECOUPLED, intrinsic controllable motion). No cos(bearing) → off-axis forward not punished → off-axis forward is no longer punished into NEGATIVE; the table STILL flattens to ~0 when STUCK (reward 0 → EMA → 0) — the hunger-gated escape recovers it. nav+turn-priority handle aiming.

params._comment: QUICK KICK away from walls: HOLD steer-away for pulse_ticks (effective impulse), then refractory release so the cog resurfaces, drives, and LEARNS the turn. pulse_ticks + refractory_ticks are live HotMutable sliders — tune the kick feel to taste.
MISMATCH stuck: commands motion but doesn't achieve it (|afferent|<<|intended|). Self-normalizing, no velocity threshold. Turning/idle (intended~0) never fires. refractory 120.
BASELINE motor bus: single reactive klino channel + whisker/stuck safety reflexes. No arbiter gain_mod (no L2 arbitration exists in this config).
